title: Unbundled finite-coefficient proper exchange and projection formulas
statement: Let l be prime and k a field of positive characteristic different from l. Let A be a finite commutative discrete topological ring killed by a power of l, R a commutative condensed ring, and e a specified isomorphism from R to the continuous condensed coefficient ring of A [lem-sf-finite-discrete-normalized-encoding]. Let p:X→Y be a proper k-morphism of separated finite-type k-schemes. For every cartesian square over p [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] and every internal module complex K on X that is bounded constructible of finite Tor amplitude [sk-def-sfb-constructible, det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude], the canonical condensedAmbientExchange [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] is invertible at K. For such K and every bounded constructible finite-Tor complex M on Y, the canonical ordinary uncompleted moduleObjectProjectionMap [def-sfb-module-object-projection-map] is invertible at K,M. The base-changed schemes are arbitrary.

source.place: Paragraph (3), application of finite proper base change to the residue inputs; the unbundled interface to the finite theorem.

proof.text: Bundle X and Y over Spec k and p as their morphism in the over-category. Obtain the normalized finite encoding for every scheme from its proved existence theorem. Apply the finite proper coefficient-isomorphism helper with the specified ring-sheaf isomorphism e. Bundling a Dctf input uses its given object and exactly its two stated properties.

The finite pullback square and the condensed ambient square are the same canonical composition comparison: their central transport is eqToIso of the same equality of scheme composites. Apply congruence to the mate operation and evaluate at the input object. Transport IsIso along this map equality to obtain the exchange clause for arbitrary base-changed schemes.

The private finite helper already has the projection clause expressed through moduleObjectProjectionMap. Its object is unchanged by bundling. Equality transport identifies the canonical instance presentations, retaining the actual projection morphism. The same equality transport compares the private proof caches with the canonical structures of this public statement.

proof_origin.place: Paragraph (3); repackaging the proved finite proper theorem while retaining its actual maps.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoefficientProperFormulas
    (R : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] [TopologicalSpace A]
    [DiscreteTopology A] [IsTopologicalRing A]
    (e : Mon.mk R ≅ Mon.mk (FiniteDiscreteOrdinary.coefficient A))
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hA : ∃ r : ℕ, (l ^ r : ℕ) • (1 : A) = 0)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ l)]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper p] :
    (∀ {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (p' : X' ⟶ Y') (g' : X' ⟶ X)
      (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' p' p g) (K : DerivedCategory (Modules R X)),
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible R X ⊓ DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _) K →
      IsIso ((condensedAmbientExchange R sq).app K)) ∧
    (∀ (K : DerivedCategory (Modules R X)) (M : DerivedCategory (Modules R Y)),
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible R X ⊓ DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _) K →
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible R Y ⊓ DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _) M →
      IsIso (moduleObjectProjectionMap R p K M))
